a: Chelev shehabbasar chofe oto muttar, alma sheal hakkesalim amar rachamana velo shebbetoch hakkesalim, hacha name sheal hakkelayot amar rachamana velo shebbetoch hakkelayot.
Gufa, amar rabbi abba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: chelev shehabbasar chofe oto – muttar. ini? vehaamar rabbi abba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hay tarba detute matne – asir!
Amar abbaye: behema bechayyeha paroke mipparka. amar rabbi yochanan: ana lav tabbacha ana velav bar tabbacha ana, unehirna dehachi havo amri be midresha: behema bechayyeha paroke mipparka.

Amar rabbi abba, amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: chelev sheal hemses uvet hakkosot (asurin) [asur], veanush karet, vezehu chelev sheal hakkerev. amar rabbi abba, amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: hay tarba diklivuseta asur, veanush karet, vezehu chelev sheal hakkesalim.

Veamar rabbi abba, amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: chutin shebbayyad asurin. amar rav safra: moshe, mi amar rachamana "la techol bisra"? amar rava: moshe, mi amar rachamana "achol dema"? chatcheh umalcheh, afillu likdera name shappir dame.
Amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: resh meayya beammeta bae gerira, vezehu chelev sheal haddakkin.

Veamar rav yehuda: chutin shebbaoketz asurin. chamsha chute it beh bechafla, telata miyyammina vetarte missemala. telata mippatzli litre tere, tere mippatzli litlata telata. nafka minna, dei shalef lehu ad dechammime – mishtallefi, vei la – bae chattote batrayyhu.
Amar abbaye, veittema rav yehuda: chamsha chute havu, telata mishshum tarba, uteren mishshum dema. ditchale udechafle udechuleyata – mishshum tarba, dida udeloa – mishshum dema.
Lemay nafka minna – hane demishshum dema, i mechattech lehu umalach lehu – shappir dame, hanach – let lehu takkanta.
Amar rav kahana, veittema rav yehuda: chamsha kerame havu, telata mishshum tarba, utere mishshum dema. ditchale dechafle udechuleyata mishshum tarba, devee udemokra mishshum dema.

Rav yehuda bar oshaya hava ka kalef leh techala lelevi bereh derav huna bar chiyyay, hava ka gaem leh meillay. amar leh: chot beh tefe. ata avu ashkecheh, amar leh: hachi amar avu deimmach mishshum derav, umannu rav yirmeya bar abba: lo asra tora ella sheal haddad bilvad.
Ini? vehaamar rav hamenuna: tana kerum sheal hattechol asur, veen chayyayvim alav. hechi dame? illema sheal haddad – ammay en chayyayvin alav? ella dechulleh. amar leh: i tanya – tanya.
Gufa, amar rav hamenuna: tana, kerum sheal hattechol asur veen chayyayvin alav, kerum sheal gabbe kuleya asur veen chayyayvin alav. vehatanya: chayyayvin alav!
Techol attechol la kashya: ha keneged haddad, ha shello keneged haddad.
Kuleya akkuleya name la kashya: ha beillaa, ha betattaa.
Bee chashilata, rav amme verav assi – chad asar vechad share. man deasar,
b: Middela ka varyayn, hane ever min hachay ninhu. man deshare, middela ka masrechan, hane chiyyuta it behu.
Veiddach, hay dela ka masrechan – dela ka shalet behu avvera, veiddach – hay dela baryayn, kechishuta hu dinkat lehu.
Amar leh rabbi yochanan lerav shemen bar abba: hane bee chashilata sharyayn, veat la techol mishshum "veal tittosh torat immecha".

Amar mar bar rav ashe: hane bee degadya, ad telatin yomin sharyayn bela kelifa, mikkan veelach – i zaran asurin, vei la zaran sharyayn. mena yadinan? i it behu shureyayke summake – asiran, let behu shureyayke summake – sharyayn.

Umetze bee umezirke, peligi ba rav acha veravina. bechol hattora kullah, ravina lekulla verav acha lechumera, vehilcheta keravina lekulla, levar mehane telat derav acha lekulla veravina lechumera, vehilcheta kerav acha lekulla.

Umetza deasmek, chatcha umalcha – afillu likdera name shappir dame. talyay name beshappuda, daev dema. aggumere – peligi ba rav acha veravina: chad amar: mishav shayvi leh, vechad amar: mitzmat tzamti leh. vechen bee, vechen mezirke.
Resha bechivsha, otveh abbet hashshechita – dayev dema ushere. atztzedadin – mikpa kafe vaasir. otveh annechireh, datz beh midde – shere, vei la – asir.
Ikka deamri: annechireh veabbet hashshechita – daev, atztzedadin – i datz beh midde – shere, vei la – asir.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, shene gidin hen: happenimi samuch laetzem – asur, vechayyayvin alav; chitzon samuch labbasar – asur, veen chayyayvin alav.
Vehatanya: penimi samuch labbasar! amar rav acha amar rav kahana: ikkelode mikkelid.
Veha tanya: chitzon hassamuch laetzem! amar rav yehuda: hecha defari tabbache.
Ittemar: tabbach shennimtza chelev acharav, rav yehuda amar: bechisora, rabbi yochanan amar: bichzayit.
Amar rav pappa: vela peligi, kan – lehalekoto, kan – leabbero.
Amar mar zutera: kisora bemakom echad, kezayit – afillu bishnayim uvishlosha mekomot. vehilcheta: lehalekoto – bichzayit, leabbero – bechisora.
En hattabbachin neemanin [vechulei]. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: chazru lomar neemanin.
Amar rav nachman: ikkashshur dare? meikkara dahavo savri la kerabbi meir – la havo mehemni, ulevassof savri kerabbi yehuda.
Ikka dematne la assefa, vachachamim omrim: neemanin alav veal hachelev. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: chazru lomar en neemanin. amar rav nachman: bizman hazze neemanin.
Ikkashshur dare? meikkara savruha kerabbi yehuda, hadar savruha kerabbi meir.
Kamma dahavo dechiri la lidrabbi yehuda – la mehemne, vehasheta deinnashyuha lidrabbi yehuda – mehemne.
Veal hachelev – chelev, man dechar shemeh? hachi kaamar: en neemanin alav veal hachelev, vachachamim omrim: neemanin alav veal hachelev.
Mishna sholeach adam yarech legoy sheggid hannashe betochah, mippene shemmekomo nikkar.
Gemara shelema – in, chatucha – la. bemay askinan? ilema bimkom sheen machrizin,

a: Chatucha name lishaddar leh, deha la atu lemizban minneh! ella bimkom shemmachrizin, shelema name la lishaddar leh, dechatech leh umezabben leh.
I baet ema – bimkom shemmachrizin, vei baet ema – bimkom sheen machrizin.
Ibbaet ema bimkom shemmachrizin – chittucha degoy midda yedia.
Veibbaet ema bimkom sheen machrizin – gezera shemma yittenenna lo bifne yisrael acher.
Vei baet ema, mishshum deka ganev leh ledateh, deamar shemuel: asur lignov daat haveriyyot, vaafillu dato shel goy.
Veha dishmuel, lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar. dishmuel hava ka avar bemabbara, amar leh leshammaeh: "payyeyseh lemabboroya", payyeyseh, veikkefad.
May tama ikkefad? amar abbaye: tarnegolet terefa havay, veyahava nihaleh bemar dishchuta. rava amar: anpaka amar leh (laashakevayy) [leashkoyeh], veashkeyeh chamra meziga.
Vechi mikkelala may? leman deamar terefa havay, amar leh: ammay teshahe issura?
Leman deamar anpaka amar leh leashkoye, anpaka chayyay mashma.
Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: al yesarhev adam lachavero lisod etzlo, veyodea bo sheeno soed, velo yarbe lo betikrovet, veyodea bo sheeno mekabbel.
Velo yiftach lo chaviyyot hammechurot lechenvani, ella im ken hodio. velo yomar lo soch shemen mippach rekan. veim bishvil kevodo – muttar.

Ini? veha ulla ikkela leve rav yehuda, patach lo chaviyyot hammechurot lachenvani! odoe odeh, veibbaet ema: shane ulla dechabbiv leh lerav yehuda, divlav hachi name (pattoche) miftach [hava patach] leh.
Tanu rabbanan: lo yelech adam levet haevel, uveyado lagin hammitkashkesh. velo yemalleennu mayim, mippene shemmatehu. veim yesh sham chever ir – muttar.
Tanu rabbanan: lo yimkor adam lachavero sandal shel meta bichlal shel chayya shechuta, mippene shene devarim: echad – mippene shemmatehu, veechad – mippene hassakkana.

Velo yeshagger adam lachavero chavit shel yayin veshemen tzaf al piha. umaase beechad sheshshigger lachavero chavit shel yayin veshemen tzaf al piha, vehalach vezimmen aleha orchin, venichnesu, metzaah shehi shel yayin, vechanak et atzmo.
Veen haorchin rashshain litten mimma shellifnehem livno ulevitto shel baal habbayit, ella im ken natlu reshut mibbaal habbayit.

Umaase beechad shezzimmen shelosha orchin bishne vatztzoret, velo haya lo lehanniach lifnehem ella keshalosh betzim. ba beno shel baal habbayit, natal echad mehen chelko unetano lo, vechen sheni, vechen shelishi. ba aviv shel tinok, metzao sheozek echad befiv ushetayim beyado, chavato bakkarka vamet. kevan sheraata immo, alta laggag venafla vameta, af hu ala laggag venafal vamet.
Amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: al davar ze nehergu shalosh nefashot miyyisrael. may kamashma lan? dechulla rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi.

Tanu rabbanan: hashsholeach yarech lachavero, shelema – eno tzarich sheyyittol hemenna gid hannashe. chatucha – tzarich littol hemenna gid hannashe. uvegoy, ben chatucha uven shelema – en tzarich littol hemenna gid hannashe.
Umippene shene devarim amru en mochrin nevelot uterefot legoy: echad – mippene shemmatehu, veechad – shemma yachzor veyimkerenna leyisrael acher.
Velo yomar adam legoy "kach li bedinar ze basar", mippene shene devarim:
b: Echad mippene haannasin, veechad shemma mochrin lo nevelot uterefot.

Amar mar: uvegoy, ben shelema ben chatucha – eno tzarich littol hemenna gid hannashe. bemay askinan? ilema bemakom shemmachrizin – chatucha ammay eno tzarich littol hemenna gid hannashe? kevan dela achruz, ate lemizban minneh.
Ella peshita bimkom sheen machrizin, ema metziata: mippene shene devarim amru en mochrin nevelot uterefot legoy: echad mippene shemmatehu, veechad shemma yachzor veyimkerenna leyisrael acher.
Vei bimkom sheen machrizin – ha la ate lemizban minneh! ella peshita bimkom shemmachrizin.

Ema sefa: lo yomar adam legoy "kach li bedinar ze basar" mippene shene devarim, echad – mippene haannasin, veechad – shemma mochrin lo nevelot uterefot, vei bimkom shemmachrizin, i ita dahava terefa – achroze havo machrezi!
Ella peshita bimkom sheen machrizin, resha vesefa bimkom sheen machrizin, metziata bimkom shemmachrizin!
Amar abbaye: in, resha vesefa bimkom sheen machrizin, metziata bimkom shemmachrizin.
Rava amar: kulla bimkom shemmachrizin. resha vesefa – shehichrizu, metziata – shello hichrizu.
Rav ashe amar: kulla bimkom sheen machrizin, umetziata gezera shemma yimkerenna bifne yisrael.
Hechi machrezinan? amar rav yitzchak bar yosef: nefal bisra livne chela.
Velema: nefal terefta livne chela! la zavni.
Veha kamate lehu? inhu hu dekamatu nafshayyhu.

Ki ha demar zutera bereh derav nachman hava kaazel missichra leve machoza, verava verav safra havo ka atu lesichra, pegau ahadade. hu savar leappeh hu dekaatu, amar lehu: lema lehu lerabbanan ditruach vaato kulle hay? amar leh rav safra: anan la hava yadinan dekaate mar, i hava yadinan tefe hava tarchinan.
Amar leh rava: may tama amart leh hachi, deachleshteh ledateh? amar leh: veha ka matenan leh! ihu hu deka mate nafsheh.
Hahu tabbacha daamar leh lechavreh:

a: I hava payysat minnay, mi la sefayi lach mishshor shel pattam daavadi etmol? amar leh: achali mishufere shufere. amar leh: menalach? amar leh: dizvan peloni goy usefa li. amar leh: tere avadi, vehahu terefa hava.
Amar rabbi: bishvil shote ze sheasa shello kahogen, anu neesor kol hammakolin?!
Rabbi letameh, daamar: makolin vetabbache yisrael, basar hannimtza beyad goy – muttar.
Ikka deamri, amar rabbi: mippene shote ze deikkavvavn letzaoreh lechavreh, anu neesor kol hammakolin?!
Tama deikkavvavn letzaoreh lechavreh, ha lav hachi, asur. vehatanya: rabbi omer: makolin vetabbache yisrael, basar hannimtza beyad goy muttar! shane hacha, deittachzak issura.
Amar rav: basar, kevan shennitallem min haayin – asur. metivi: rabbi omer: makolin vetabbache yisrael, basar hannimtza beyad goy – muttar. nimtza beyad goy – shane.

Ta shama: tesha chanuyot, kullan mochrot besar shechuta, veachat mocheret besar nevela, velakach meachat mehen veeno yodea meeze mehen lakach – sefeko asur, uvenimtza hallech achar harov. hacha name – benimtza beyad goy.
Ta shema: matza bah basar (im chay) – hallech achar rov tabbachim, veim mevushshal – hallech achar rov ochle vasar.
Vechi tema: hacha name benimtza beyad goy, mevushshal hallech achar rov ochle vasar? venechze: i degoy naket leh, i deyisrael naket leh! hacha bemay askinan: beomed veroehu.
Ta shema: nimtza baggevulin, evarim – nevelot, chatichot – muttarot. vechi tema: hacha name beomed veroehu, evarim nevelot – ammay?
Midde hu tama ella lerav, ha ittemar ala: rav amar muttarot mishshum nevela, velevi amar muttarot baachila.
Veha derav, lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar. derav hava yatev ammabbara deishtatya, chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava ka
b: Mechavvavr resha, nefal minneh, azal ayyti silta sheda assek teren, amar rav: avdi name hachi, asrinhu nihaleh.
Amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: deissura shechichi, dehettera la shechichi? amar lehu: deissura shechichi tefe.
Vechi mikkelala, may? parvevta degoyim havay, teda, dekaamar lehu: "deissura shechichi tefe".
Ella rav, hechi achal bisra beshateh, dela (olim) [maalem] eneh minneh? ibbaet ema: betzayyra vachatima, vei name: besimana, ki ha derabba bar rav huna mechattech leh attelat karnata.
Rav hava kaazel leve rav chanan chatneh, chaza mabbara dekaate leappeh, amar: mabbara kaate leappay, yoma tava lego.

Azal, kam abbava, odek beviza dedashsha, chaza chevta detalya, teraf abbava, nefuk ato kulle alma leappeh, ata tabbache name, la allem rav eneh minneh, amar lehu: ikko hasheta sefitu lehu issura livne verat. la achal rav mehahu bisra.
May tama? i mishshum iallome – ha la iallaym, ella denachesh.
Vehaamar rav: kol nachash sheeno keeliezer eved avraham ucheyonatan ben shaul – eno nachash! ella seudat harshut havay, verav la mithane misseudat harshut.
Rav badek bemabbara, ushemuel badek besifra, rabbi yochanan badek beyanoka.

Kullehu shene derav, hava katav leh rabbi yochanan "lokodam rabbenu shebbevavel". ki nach nafsheh, hava katav lishmuel "lokodam chaverenu shebbevavel". amar: la yada li midde derabbeh ana? ketav shaddar leh ibbura deshittin shene. amar: hasheta chushebana bealma yada.
Ketav shaddar leh telesar gamle sefeke terefta, amar: it li rav bevavel, ezil ichzeyeh. amar leh leyanoka: pesok li pesukaych, amar leh: "ushemuel met", amar: shema minna nach nafsheh dishmuel.
Vela hi, la shechev shemuel, ella ki hechi dela litrach rabbi yochanan.
Tanya: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: bayit, tinok, veishsha – af al pi sheen nachash, yesh siman.
Amar rabbi elazar: vehu deittachzak telata zimne, dichtiv: "yosef enennu veshimon enennu veet binyamin tikkachu".
Bea minneh rav huna merav: bacharuzin mahu? amar leh: al tehi shote, bacharuzin hare ze siman. ikka deamri: amar rav huna amar rav: bacharuzin hare ze siman.
Rav nachman minnehardea ikkela legabbe rav kahana lefum nahara bemaale yoma dechippure, ato orve shadu kavde vechuleyata, amar leh: shekol veechol, haiddana dehettera shechiach tefe.
Rav chiyyay bar avin ittevad leh karkesha be dina, ata lekammeh derav huna. amar leh: it lach simana begavveh? amar leh: la. it lach teviut ena begavveh? amar leh: in. im ken, zil shekol.
Rav chanina chozaa ittevad leh gabba devisra, ata lekammeh derav nachman. amar leh: it lach simana begavveh? amar leh: la. it lach teviut ena begavveh? amar leh: in. im ken, zil shekol.
Rav natan bar abbaye ittevad leh kibbura ditchelta, ata lekammeh derav chisda. amar leh: it lach simana begavveh? amar leh: la. it lach teviut ena begavveh? amar leh: in. im ken, zil shekol.
Amar rava: meresha hava amena simana adif mitteviut ena, deha mahderinan avedta besimana,

a: Vela mahderinan bitviut ena. hasheta dishmatinhu lehane shematata, amena: teviut ena adifa.
Dei la tema hachi, heach some muttar beishto, uvene adam ech muttarin binshotehen ballayla? ella bitviut ena dekala, hacha name bitviut ena.
Amar rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya: teda, deillu atu bitre veamri: pelanya, dehay simaneh vehay simaneh, ketal nafsha – la katlinan leh, veillu amri: it lan teviut ena begavveh – katlinan leh.
Amar rav ashe: teda, deillu amar leh inish lishlucheh: karyeh liflanya, dehay simaneh vehay simaneh – safek yada leh, safek la yada leh, veillu it leh teviut ena begavveh – ki chaze leh, yada leh.
Mishna hannotel gid hannashe, tzarich sheyyittol et kullo. rabbi yehuda omer: kede lekayyem bo mitzvat netila.
Haochel miggid hannashe kezayit – sofeg arbaim. achalo veen bo kezayit – chayyayv. achal mizze kezayit umizze kezayit – sofeg shemonim. rabbi yehuda omer: eno sofeg ella arbaim.
Gemara bar payole hava kae kammeh dishmuel, veka menakkar atma. hava ka gaem leh, amar leh: chot beh tefe, hasheta la chazetach – sefet li issura!
Irtat, nefal sakkina mideh. amar leh: la tirtat, deori lach kerabbi yehuda ori lach.
Amar rav sheshet: may dishkal bar payole – deorayyta, lerabbi yehuda. mikkelal deshayyayr – derabbanan, lerabbi yehuda. ella, deori leh keman ori leh?
Ella amar rav sheshet: may dishkal bar payole – deorayyta, umay deshayyayr – derabbanan, lerabbi meir; dei rabbi yehuda – afillu midderabbanan shere.
Haochel miggid hannashe [vechulei]. amar shemuel: lo asra tora ella sheal hakkaf bilvad, shenneemar: "al kaf hayyarech".
Amar rav pappa: ketannae, achalo veen bo kezayit – chayyayv. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyehe bo kezayit.
May tama derabbanan? beriyya (bifne atzmah) hi.
b: Verabbi yehuda – achila ketiva beh, verabbanan – hahi achila dechi it beh arbaa vachamishsha zetim vaachal chad kezayit michayyayv.
Verabbi yehuda, measher al kaf hayyarech" nafka.
Verabbanan, hahu mibbee leh lichdishmuel, deamar shemuel: lo asra tora ella sheal kaf hayyarech. verabbi yehuda – "hayyarech" ketiv, dechulla yarech.
Verabbanan, hahu defashet issureh bechullay yarech, leappoke chitzon dela, uleolam sheal hakkaf.
Vehay "kaf" mibbee leh lemaote of, delet leh kaf! tere "kaf" ketivi.
Mishna yarech shennitbashshel bah gid hannashe, im yesh bah benoten taam – hare zo asura. ketzad meshaarin otah? kevasar belefet.
Gid hannashe shennitbashshel im haggidim, bizman shemmakkiro – benoten taam, veim lav – kullan asurin, veharotev benoten taam.
Vechen chaticha shel nevela, vechen chaticha shel dag tame shennitbashshela im hachatichot, bizman shemmakkiran – benoten taam, veim lav – kullan asurot, veharotev benoten taam.
Gemara amar shemuel: lo shanu ella shennitbashshel bah, aval nitzla bah – kolef veochel ad shemmaggia laggid.
Ini? vehaamar rav huna: gedi shetztzelao bechelbo – asur leechol afillu merosh ozno!

a: Shane chelev, dimfapa.

Uvechelev asur? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana: ovada hava kammeh derabbi yochanan bichnishta demaon, bigdi shetztzelao bechelbo, vaato veshayylu lerabbi yochanan, veamar: kolef veochel ad shemmaggia lechelbo! hahu kachush hava.
Rav huna bar yehuda amar: kuleya bechelbah hava, vesharya. ravin bar rav adda amar: kilkit beilpas hava, vaato shayylu lerabbi yochanan, vaamar lehu: litameh kappila arammaa.

Amar rava: meresh hava ka kashya li ha detanya: kedera shebbishshel bah basar – lo yevashshel bah chalav, veim bishshel – benoten taam; teruma – lo yevashshel bah chullin, veim bishshel – benoten taam.
Bishlama teruma, taem la kohen, ella basar bechalav – man taem leh? hasheta deamar rabbi yochanan: samchinan akkappila arammaa, hacha name samchinan akkappila arammaa.
Deamar rava: amur rabbanan betama, vaamur rabbanan bekappila,
b: Vaamur rabbanan beshishshim. hilkach, min besheeno mino dehettera – betama, deissura – bekappila.
Umin bemino, delekka lemekam attama, i name min besheeno mino deissura, delekka kappila – beshishshim.
Hanhu atmahata deimmelichu be resh galuta begida nashya, ravina asar, rav acha bar rav ashe share. ato shayylu lemar bar rav ashe, amar lehu: abba share.
Amar leh rav acha bar rav leravina: may dataych – deamar shemuel: maliach hare hu keroteach, kavush hare hu kimvushshal.
Vehaamar shemuel: lo shanu ella shennitbashshel bah, aval nitzla bah – kolef veochel ad shemmaggia laggid.
Vechi tema, may keroteach dekaamar? keroteach dimvushshal! veha middekaamar kavush hare hu kimvushshal, mikkelal deroteach detzali kaamar. kashya.
Amar rabbi chanina: keshehen meshaarin, meshaarin berotev uvakkefe uvachatichot uvikdera. ikka deamri: bikdera atzmah, veikka deamri: bemay devala kedera.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: kol issurin shebbattora (meshaarinan) [meshaarin otan] keillu hen batzal vekaflot.
Amar leh rabbi abba leabbaye: uleshaarinhu befilpelin vetavlin, daafillu beelef lo betelin! amar leh: shiaru chachamim deen noten taam beissurin yoter mibbatzal vekaflot.
Amar rav nachman: gid beshishshim, veen gid min hamminyan; kechal beshishshim, uchechal min hamminyan; betza beshishshim, veen betza min hamminyan.
Amar rabbi yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya: uchechal atzmo asur, vei nafal likdera acheret – oser.
Amar rav ashe: ki havenan be rav kahana, ibbaya lan: ki meshaarinan bedideh meshaarinan, o bemay dinfak minneh meshaarinan?
Peshita divdideh meshaarinan, dei bema dinfak minneh – mena yadinan? ella meatta, nafal likdera acheret – lo yeesor?
Kevan deamar rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya: uchechal atzmo asur, shavveyu rabbanan kachaticha dinvela.
Betza beshishshim, veen betza min hamminyan. amar leh rav idi bar avin leabbaye: lememra deyahava tama? veha amri inashe: ki mayya devee bealma!
Amar leh: hacha bemay askinan?

a: Bevetzat efroach, aval temea – la.
Etiveh: betzim tehorot sheshshelakan im betzim temeot, im yesh bahen benoten taam – kullan asurot. hacha name bevetzat efroach, veammay kare la "temea"? kevan deit ba efroach, kare la "temea".
Veha middekatane sefa: betzim sheshshelakan venimtza efroach beachat mehen, im yesh bahen benoten taam – kullan asurot, mikkelal deresha delet ba efroach askinan.
Payrushe ka mefaresh: betzim tehorot sheshshelakan im betzim temeot, im yesh bahen benoten taam – kullan asurot. ketzad? kegon sheshshelakan venimtza efroach beachat mehen.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach resha delet ba efroach – hasheta delet ba efroach asura, deit ba efroach mibbaya?

I mishshum ha la irya, tena sefa legalloye resha, shello tomar: resha – deit ba efroach, aval let ba efroach – sharya, tena sefa deit ba efroach, mikkelal deresha delet ba efroach, vaafillu hachi asira.
Hahu kezeta tarba dinfal bedikkula devisra, savar rav assi leshaoreh bemay divla dikkula, amri leh rabbanan lerav ashe: attu dehettera bala, deissura la bala?

Hahu palga dezeta detarba dinfal bedikkula devisra, savar mar bar rav ashe leshaoreh bitlatin palge dezeta. amar leh avu: lav amena lach la tezalzel beshiurin derabbanan? veod, haamar rabbi yochanan: chatzi shiur asur min hattora.

Amar rav shemen bar abba, amar rav idi bar idi bar gershom, amar levi bar perata, amar rabbi nachum, amar rabbi biryaym mishshum zaken echad, verabbi yaakov shemeh, deve nesia amru: betza beshishshim – asura, beshishshim veachat – mutteret.

Amar rabbi zera lerav shemen bar abba: ree sheatta metil bah gevul hetter, shehare shene gedole haddor lo pershu et haddavar. rabbi yaakov bar idi verabbi shemuel bar nachmani, tarvayyhu mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi amri: betza beshishshim – asura, beshishshim veachat – mutteret.
Veibbaya lehu: beshishshim veachat, bahade dida, o dilma levar minna? vela peshut, umar pashet la mifshat.
Ittemar, amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna: betza beshishshim vehi – asura, beshishshim veachat vehi – mutteret.
Hahu daata lekammeh derabban gamliel bar rabbi, amar leh: abba lo shier bearbaim vasheva, vaani ashaer bearbaim vechamesh.
Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi shimon bar rabbi, amar leh: abba lo shier bearbaim vechamesh, vaani ashaer bearbaim veshalosh.
Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi chiyyay, amar leh: kelum yesh sheloshim?
Tama delekka sheloshim, ha ikka sheloshim – meshaarin? amar rabbi chanina: guzema.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: kol issurin shebbattora beshishshim. amar lefanav rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: rabbi, atta omer ken? hachi amar rav assi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: kol issurin shebbattora bemea!
Ushenehem lo lemaduha ella mizzeroa beshela", dichtiv: "velakach hakkohen et hazzeroa beshela vegomer", vetanya: "beshela" –
b: En "beshela" ella shelema. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: en "beshela" ella shennitbashshela im haayil.
Dechulle alma bahade ayil mevashshel la, mar savar: mechattech la vahadar mevashshel la, umar savar: mevashshel la vahadar mechattech la.
Vei baet ema, dechulle alma mechattech la vahadar mevashshel la, mihu mar savar: bahade ayil mevashshel la, umar savar: bikdera acheret mevashshel la.
Lelishshana kamma – allibba dedivre hakkol, lelishshana batra – allibba derabbi shimon ben yochay.
Man deamar beshishshim, savar: basar vaatzamot bahade basar vaatzamot meshaarinan, vehave leh beshishshim. man deamar bemea, savar: basar bahade basar meshaarinan, vehave leh bemea.
Umi yalfinan minna? vehatanya: zehu hetter habba mikkelal issur, "zehu" lemaote may? lav lemaote kol issurin shebbattora!
Amar abbaye: lo nitzrecha ella lerabbi yehuda, deamar min bemino lo batel, ka mashma lan dehacha batel.
Veligmar minneh? galli rachamana "velakach middam happar umiddam hassair", tarvayyhu bahade hadade ninhu vela batli.
Umay chazet degamrinan mehaych, ligmar mehay? chiddush hu, umechiddush la gamrinan.
I hachi, lemea veshishshim name la ligmar?
Attu anan lekulla gamrinan? lechumera gamrinan, demiddeorayyta berubba batel.
Rava amar: lo nitzrecha ella letaam keikkar, divkadashim asur, ka mashma lan dehacha share.

a: Veligmar minneh? galli rachamana gabbe chattat: "kol asher yigga bivsarah yikdash", lihyot kamoha – sheim pesula tippasel, veim keshera teachel kechamur shebbah.
Umay chazet degamrinan mehaych, ligmar mehay? chiddush hu, umechiddush la gamrinan.
I hachi, lemea veshishshim name la ligmar? attu anan lekulla ka gamrinan? lechumera ka gamrinan, demiddeorayyta berubba batel.
Ravina amar: lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach, deamar: mekom chatach bealma asur, vehacha shere.
Yatev rav dimi, vekaamar la leha shemata.
Amar leh abbaye: vechol issurin shebbattora bemea? vehatnan: lama amru kol hamechammetz umetabbel umedammea lehachemir – min umino, lehakel ulehachmir – min vesheeno mino.

Vekatane sefa lehakel ulehachmir min vesheeno mino, ketzad? gerisin shennitbashshelu im haadashim, im yesh bahem benoten taam, ben yesh bahen lehaalot bemea veechad, ben en bahen lehaalot bemea veechad – asur.
En bahen benoten taam, ben sheyyesh bahen lehaalot bemea veechad, ben en bahen lehaalot bemea veechad – muttar.
En bahen lehaalot bemea veechad, ella bemay? lav beshishshim?
b: La, bemea.

Veha midderesha bemea have, sefa beshishshim! dekatane resha: lehachemir min umino ketzad? seor shel chittin shennafal leissat chittin, veyesh bo kede lechammetz, ben yesh bo kede lehaalot bemea veechad, ben en bo kede lehaalot bemea veechad – asur.
En bo lehaalot bemea veechad, ben sheyyesh bo kede lechammetz, ben en bo kede lechammetz – asur. resha vesefa bima?
La, resha bima vechad, vesefa bima.
Vechi yesh bo kede lechammetz bima vechad, ammay la betil? ishtik.

Amar leh: dilma shane seor dechimmutzo kashe. amar leh: adkartan milleta deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: lo kol hashshiurin shavin, shehare tzir shiuro karov lematayim. ditnan: dag tame tziro asur, rabbi yehuda omer: reviit besatayim.
Vehaamar rabbi yehuda: min bemino lo batel? shane tzir, dezea bealma hu.
Ketzad meshaarinan? amar rav huna: kevasar berashe lefatot. matnitin dela kehay tanna, detanya: rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: en begidin benoten taam.
Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi chanina, hava yatev rabbi yehuda bar zevina abbava. ki nefak, amar leh: may amar lach? amar leh: sharya nihaleh.
Amar leh hadar ayyeylay lekammeh, amar: man hay deka metzaar li? zil ema leh leman deyatev abbava: en begidin benoten taam.
Ki ato lekammeh derabbi amme, meshaddar lehu lekammeh derabbi yitzchak ben chaluv, demore ba lehettera mishshum derabbi yehoshua ben levi, veleh la sevira leh. vehilcheta: en begidin benoten taam.
Gid hannashe shennitbashshel. velivtol berubba!

a: Beriyya shane.
Vechen chaticha shel nevela [vechulei]. vetivtel berubba!
Hanicha leman deamar, kol sheddarko limmanot shaninu, ella leman deamar et sheddarko limmanot shaninu, may ikka lememar? shane chaticha, hoil ureuya lehitkabbed bah lifne haorchim.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan gid – mishshum divriyya hi, aval chaticha – ema la.
Vei ashmeinan chaticha, hoil ureuya lehitkabbed bah lifne haorchim, aval gid – ema la. tzericha.
Daresh rabba bar bar chana: chaticha shel nevela veshel dag tame enah oseret, ad shettitten taam barotev uvakkefe uvachatichot.
Oke rav amora aleh, uderash: kevan shennatan taam bachaticha – chaticha atzmah naaset nevela, veoseret kol hachatichot kullan mippene shehen minah.

Amar leh rav safra leabbaye: mikkede rav keman amra lishmateh? kerabbi yehuda, deamar min bemino lo batel. may irya ki natan taam? afillu ki lo natan taam name! amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – beshekkadam vesilleko.
Rava amar:
b: Afillu tema lo kadam vesilleko, have min umino vedavar acher.
Vechol min umino vedavar acher – sallek et mino kemi sheeno, vesheen mino rave alav umevattelo.

Mishna noheg bithora, veeno noheg bitmea. rabbi yehuda omer: af bitmea. amar rabbi yehuda: vahalo mibbene yaakov neesar gid hannashe, vaadayin behema temea mutteret lahen? amru lo: besinay neemar, ella shennichtav bimkomo.
Gemara vesavar rabbi yehuda issur chal al issur? vehatanya: rabbi yehuda omer: yachol tehe nivlat of tame metammea begadim bevet habbelia?
Talmud lomar "nevela uterefa lo yochal letoma vah" – mi sheissuro mishshum "bal tochal nevela", yatza ze sheen issuro mishshum "bal tochal nevela" ella mishshum "bal tochal temea".
Vechi tema, kasavar en begidin benoten taam, uvitmea name issur gid ikka, issur tumea lekka.
Vesavar rabbi yehuda en begidin benoten taam? vehatanya: haochel gid hannashe shel behema temea – rabbi yehuda mechayyev shetayim, verabbi shimon poter!
Leolam, kasavar yesh begidin benoten taam, vekasavar noheg bashshelil, deissur gid veissur tumea bahade hadade kaate.
Umi matzet amrat noheg bashshelil? vehatnan: noheg bashshelil, rabbi yehuda omer: eno noheg bashshelil, vechelbo muttar!
Hane mille gabbe tehora, derachamana amar: "kol babbehema tochelu", aval bitmea noheg.
Umi matzet amrat detarvayyhu bahade hadade kaatu? vehatnan: al ellu tumeot hannazir megalleach, al hammet veal kezayit min hammet.
Vekashya lan: al kezayit min hammet megalleach, al hammet kullo lo kol shekken? veamar rabbi yochanan: lo nitzrecha ella lenefel shello nitkashsheru evarav begidin. alma issur tumea kadem!
Af al gav deissur tumea kadem, ate issur gid chayel aleh, shekken issuro noheg bivne noach.
Dayka name, dekatane: amar rabbi yehuda: vahalo mibbene yaakov neesar gid hannashe, vaadayin behema temea mutteret lahem.
Gufa: haochel gid hannashe shel behema temea – rabbi yehuda mechayyev shetayim,

a: Verabbi shimon poter.
Verabbi shimon, ma nafshach? i issur chal al issur – lichayyayv name mishshum gid, i en issur chal al issur – lichayyayv mishshum tumea dikdem, vei en begidin benoten taam – lichayyayv mishshum gid.
Amar rava: leolam kasavar en begidim benoten taam, veshane hatam deamar kera: "al ken lo yochlu vene yisrael et gid hannashe", mi sheggido asur uvesaro muttar, yatzta zo sheggido asur uvesaro asur.
Amar rav yehuda, amar rav: haochel gid hannashe shel nevela – rabbi meir mechayyev shetayim, vachachamim omrim: eno chayyayv ella achat.
Umodim chachamim lerabbi meir beochel gid hannashe shel ola veshel shor hanniskal, shechayyayv shetayim.
Uman hay tanna, divissur kolel – issur chal al issur let leh, issur kolel beissur chamur – it leh.
Amar rava: rabbi yose haggelili hi, ditnan: tame sheachal kodesh, ben kodesh tame ben kodesh tahor – chayyayv.
Rabbi yose haggelili omer: tame sheachal et hattahor – chayyayv, tame sheachal et hattame – patur, shello achal ella davar tame.
Amru lo: af tame sheachal et hattahor, kevan shennaga bo, timmeahu.
Shappir ka amri leh rabbanan lerabbi yose haggelili, veamar rava: benitma hagguf veachar kach nitma basar – kulle alma la peligi dechayyayv, deissur karet kadem.
Ki peligi benitma basar, veachar kach nitma hagguf. rabbanan it lehu issur kolel, demiggo demichayyayv achatichot tehorot dealma, michayyayv name achaticha temea.
Verabbi yose haggelili let leh issur kolel, demiggo la amrinan.
Verabbi yose haggelili, nehi deissur kolel let leh, beissur kal yavo issur chamur yachul al issur kal, umay nihu? tumeat hagguf, shehare tumeat hagguf becharet.
Amar rav ashe: man lema lan detumeat hagguf chamura, dilma tumeat basar chamura, delet leh tohora bemikve.
b: Verabbi yose haggelili let leh issur kolel?

Vehatanya: shabbat veyom hakkippurim, shagag veasa melacha, minnayin shechayyayv al ze beatzmo veal ze beatzmo? talmud lomar: "shabbat hi", "yom hakkippurim hu", divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: eno chayyayv ella achat.
Shelach ravin mishshum derabbi yose berabbi chanina: kach hatztzaa shel mishna, veefoch.

Shelach rav yitzchak bar yaakov bar giyyore mishshum derabbi yochanan: ledivre rabbi yose haggelili, lemay daafachan, shagag beshabbat vehezid beyom hakkippurim – chayyayv, hezid beshabbat veshagag beyom hakkippurim – patur.
May tama? amar abbaye: shabbat kevia vekayyma, yom hakkippurim – be dina deka kavi leh.
Amar leh rava: sof sof, tarvayyhu bahade hadade kaatu. ella amar rava: shemada hava, ushelachu mittam deyoma dechippure deha shatta shabbeta hu. vechen ki ata ravin vechol nachote amruha kerava.
Amar rabbi yehuda: vahalo mibbene yaakov [vechulei].

Tanya, amru lo lerabbi yehuda: vechi neemar "al ken lo yochlu bene yaakov"? vahalo lo neemar ella "bene yisrael", velo nikreu "bene yisrael" ad sinay! ella besinay neemar, ella shennichtav bimkomo leda meeze taam neesar lahem.
Metiv rava: "vayyisu vene yisrael et yaakov avihem", leachar maase.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: mehahi shata littesar.
Amar leh: vechi tora peamim peamim nittena? hahu shata lav sheat maase havay, vela sheat mattan tora havay.
Tanu rabbanan: ever min hachay noheg bivhema, chayya vaof, ben temein uven tehorin, divre rabbi yehuda verabbi elazar. vachachamim omrim: eno noheg ella bithorin.
Amar rabbi yochanan: ushenehen mikra echad darshu, "rak chazak levilti achol haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh

a: Lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar". rabbi yehuda verabbi elazar savri: kol sheatta metzvvev al damo atta metzvvev al evarav, vehane temein name, hoil veatta metzvvev al daman atta metzvvev al evarayn.
Verabbanan savri: "lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar", ella basar lechodeh, kol shebbesaro muttar – atta metzvvev al evarav, vechol sheen besaro muttar – i atta metzvvev al evarav.
Verabbi yehuda, lema leh kera? lete issur ever lechul al issur tumea, shekken issuro noheg bivne noach!
In hachi name, vechi itzterich kera lerabbi elazar.
Tanya name hachi: ever min hachay noheg bivhema chayya vaof, ben temea ben tehora, shenneemar "rak chazak levilti achol haddam".
Kol sheatta metzvvev al damo – atta metzvvev al evarav, vechol shei atta metzvvev al damo – i atta metzvvev al evarav, divre rabbi elazar.

Vachachamim omrim: eno noheg ella bithorin, shenneemar "lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar", ella basar lechodeh, kol shebbesaro muttar – atta metzvvev al evarav, vechol sheen besaro muttar – en atta metzvvev al evarav.
Rabbi meir omer: eno noheg ella bivhema tehora bilvad.
(Siman: shemuel, shela, shimi).

Amar rabba bar shemuel amar rav chisda, veittema rav yosef, veamri la amar rabba bar shela amar rav chisda, veittema rav yosef, veamri la rabba bar shimi amar rav chisda, veittema rav yosef: may tama derabbi meir?
Amar kera "vezavachta mibbekarcha umitztzoncha".
Amar rav giddel, amar rav: machloket beyisrael, aval beven noach – divre hakkol muzehar al hattemein kattehorin.
Tanya name hachi: ever min hachay – ben noach muzehar alav al hattemeim kattehorim, veyisrael eno muzehar ella al hattehorin bilvad.
Ikka deamri "tehora", verabbi meir. ikka deamri "tehorim", verabbanan.
Amar rav shezvi: af anan name tenena, achal ever min hachay mimmenna eno sofeg arbaim, veen shechita metahartah.
Bemay? ilema beyisrael – peshita deen shechita metahartah! ella lav bivne noach, mikkelal deasur.
Rabbi mani bar pattish rame resha assefa, umeshanne: resha beyisrael, vesefa beven noach.
Amar rav: ever min hachay tzarich kezayit, may tama? achila ketiva beh.
Metiv rav amram: achal ever min hachay mimmenna – eno sofeg et haarbaim, veen shechita metahartah. vei salka datach baenan kezayit – tippok leh dekaachel kezayit.
Kidamar rav nachman, bemashshehu basar gidin vaatzamot, hacha name bemashshehu basar gidin vaatzamot.
Ta shema, deamar rav:
b: Achal tzippor tehora bechayyeha – bechol shehu, bemitatah – bichzayit, utemea ben bechayyeha ben bemitatah – bechol shehu, hacha name bemashshehu basar gidim vaatzamot.

Ta shema: natal tzippor sheen bo kezayit vaachalo – rabbi poter, verabbi elazar bar rabbi shimon mechayyev. amar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: kal vachomer, al ever mimmenna chayyayv, al kullah lo kol shekken! chanakah vaachalah – divre hakkol bichzayit.
Ad kan la peligi, ella demar savar: bechayyeha leevarim omedet, umar savar: bechayyeha lav leevarim omedet.
Dechulle alma miha la baenan kezayit, amar rav nachman: bemashshehu basar, gidim vaatzamot.
Umi ikka midde, divchulleh let beh kezayit basar, uvechad ever it kezayit bemashshehu basar gidin vaatzamot? amar rav sherevya: in, biklanita.
Ema sefa: chanakah vaachalah, divre hakkol bichzayit, veha kelanita of tame hu, veamar rav: temea, ben bechayyeha ben bemitatah, bemashshehu! ella keen kelanita.
Amar rava: im timtze lomar savar rabbi machshevet ochalin shemah machshava, chishshev leochlah ever ever, vaachalah kullah – chayyayv.
Amar leh abbaye: umi ikka midde, deillu achel leh acher – la michayyayv, veachel leh hay – michayyayv? amar leh: ze lefi machshavto, veze lefi machshavto.
Veamar rava: im timtze lomar savar rabbi elazar bar rabbi shimon machshevet ochalin shemah machshava, chishshev leochlah meta, vaachalah chayya – patur.
Amar leh abbaye: umi ikka midde, deillu achel leh acher michayyayv, veachel leh hay patur? amar leh: ze lefi machshavto, veze lefi machshavto.
Amar rabbi yochanan: "lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar" – ze ever min hachay, "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu" – ze basar min hachay uvasar min hatterefa.
Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: "lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar" – ze ever min hachay uvasar min hachay, "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu" – ze basar min hatterefa.

Achal ever min hachay uvasar min hachay – lerabbi yochanan chayyayv shetayim, lerabbi shimon ben lakish eno chayyayv ella achat. achal basar min hachay uvasar min hatterefa – lerabbi shimon ben lakish chayyayv shetayim, lerabbi yochanan eno chayyayv ella achat. achal ever min hachay uvasar min hatterefa – ledivre hakkol chayyayv shetayim.
Ureminhu:

a: Achal ever min hachay min hatterefa, rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv shetayim, verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: eno chayyayv ella achat.
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan nicha, ella lerabbi shimon ben lakish kashya.
Amar rav yosef: la kashya, kan bivhema achat, kan bishte behemot. bishte behemot michayyayv shetayim, bivhema achat peligi.
Bivhema achat, bemay peligi? amar abbaye: kegon shennitrefa im yetziat rubbah, mar savar: behema bechayyeha leevarim omedet, veissur terefa veissur ever bahade hadade kaatu.
Umar savar, behema bechayyeha lav leevarim omedet, vela ate issur ever chayel aissur terefa.

Veibbaet ema, dechulle alma behema bechayyeha lav leevarim omedet, uvemete issur ever mechal aissur terefa ka mippalgi: mar savar ate issur ever chayel aissur terefa, umar savar la ate issur ever chayel aissur terefa.
Ibbaet ema, dechulle alma behema bechayyeha leevarim omedet, uchegon shennitrefa leachar mikkan, uvemete issur terefa chayel aissur ever ka mippalgi.
Mar savar ate vechayel, umar savar la ate vechayel.
Rava amar: kegon shettalash mimmenna ever uterafah bo. mar savar: behema bechayyeha leevarim enah omedet, issur ever veissur terefa bahade hadade kaatu.
Umar savar, behema bechayyeha leevarim omedet, vela ate issur terefa chayel aissur ever.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: achal chelev min hachay min hatterefa – chayyayv shetayim. amar leh rabbi amme: velema mar shalosh, sheani omer shalosh. ittemar name, amar rabbi avahu, amar rabbi yochanan: achal chelev min hachay min hatterefa – chayyayv shalosh.
Bemay kamippalgi, kegon shennitrefa im yetziat rubbah. man deamar shalosh, kasavar: behema bechayyeha leevarim omedet, deissur chelev veissur ever veissur terefa bahade hadade kaatu.
Uman deamar shetayim, kasavar behema bechayyeha lav leevarim omedet, veissur chelev veissur terefa – ikka, issur ever – la ate chayel.
Vei baet ema, dechulle alma behema bechayyeha lav leevarim omedet, uvemete issur ever vechayel aissur chelev veaissur terefa ka mippalgi, mar savar ate chayel, umar savar la ate chayel.
Vei baet ema, dechulle alma behema bechayyeha leevarim omedet, uchegon shennitrefa leachar mikkan, uvemete issur terefa mechal aissur ever ka mippalgi.
Mar savar: ate chayel, midde dehave achelev, deamar mar: hattora amra yavo issur nevela yachul al issur chelev, veyavo issur terefa yachul al issur chelev.
Veiddach, achelev hu dechayyayv, dehuttar
b: Mikkelalo, aval ever delo huttar mikkelalo – la.
Ki ata rav dimi amar: bea minneh rabbi shimon ben lakish merabbi yochanan: chilleko mibbachutz, mahu? amar leh: patur.
Mibbifnim, may? amar leh: chayyayv.
Ki ata ravin amar: chilleko mibbachutz – patur, mibbefanim – rabbi yochanan amar chayyayv, veresh lakish amar patur.
Rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, hare nehena gerono bichzayit. veresh lakish amar: patur, achila bemeav baenan velekka.
Ella lerabbi shimon ben lakish, hechi mashkachat la dimchayyev? amar rav kahana: bigromita zeerta.
Verabbi elazar amar: afillu chilleko mibbachutz name chayyayv, mechussar keriva lav kimchussar maase dame.
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kezayit sheamru – chutz mishshel ben hashshinnayim, verabbi yochanan amar: af im ben hashshinnayim.
Amar rav pappa: beshel ben shinnayim – dechulle alma la peligi, ki peligi – ben hachanichayim. mar savar: hare nehena gerono bichzayit, umar savar: achila bemeav baenan.
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: achal chatzi zayit vehekio, vechazar veachal chatzi zayit acher – chayyayv. may tama? hare nehena gerono bichzayit.
Bea rabbi elazar merabbi assi: achal chatzi zayit vehekio vechazar vaachalo, mahu? may ka mibbaya leh? i have ikkul i la have ikkul, vetibbee leh kezayit!
Ella, i batar gerono azlinan, i batar meav azlinan. vetifshot leh midderabbi assi!

Rabbi assi gemareh iakar leh, vaata rabbi elazar leadkoreh, vehachi kaamar leh: lema li chatzi zayit acher? lema mar bedideh, deikka lemishma minna tarte: shaminan minna dela have ikkul, veshaminan minna dahare nehena gerono bichzayit.
Ishtik vela amar leh vela midde, amar leh: mofet haddor, la zimnin saggiin amrat kammeh derabbi yochanan, veamar lach: hare nehena gerono bichzayit?
Hadaran alach gid hannashe.
Mishna kol habbasar asur levashshel bechalav, chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim, veasur lehaalot im haggevina al hashshulchan, chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim.

a: Hannoder min habbasar muttar bivsar dagim vachagavim.
Gemara ha of asur middeorayyta, keman? dela kerabbi akiva, dei rabbi akiva – haamar: chayya vaof eno min hattora.
Ema sefa: hannoder min habbasar – muttar bivsar dagim vachagavim, ha of asur, atan lerabbi akiva, deamar: kol mille demimmelich aleh shaliach – bar mineh hu.
Detanya: hannoder min hayyarak, muttar baddilluin, verabbi akiva oser. amru lo lerabbi akiva: vahalo omer adam lishlucho "kach lanu yarak", vehu omer "lo matzati ella dilluin"!
Amar lahen: ken haddavar, kelum omer "lo matzati ella kitnit"?! ella sheddilluin bichlal yarak, veen kitnit bichlal yarak. resha rabbanan, vesefa rabbi akiva!
Amar rav yosef: rabbi hi, venasev la allibba detannae, bindarim savar la kerabbi akiva, bevasar bechalav savar la kerabbanan.

Rav ashe amar: kulla rabbi akiva hi, vehachi kaamar: kol habbasar asur levashshel bechalav, mehen middivre tora umehen middivre sofrim, chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim, sheenam lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim.
Veasur lehaalot [vechulei]. amar rav yosef: shema minna besar of bechalav deorayyta, dei salka datach derabbanan – achila gufa gezera, vaanan nigzar haalaa attu achila?
Umena temra dela gazrinan gezera ligzera? ditnan: challat chutza laaretz
b: Neechelet im hazzar al hashshulchan, venittenet lechol kohen sheyyirtze.
Amar leh abbaye: bishlama i ashmoinan challat chutza laaretz baaretz, deikka lemigzar mishshum challat haaretz deorayyta, vela gazrinan – ikka lemishma minna.
Ella chutza learetz, mishshum delekka lemigzar hu. aval hacha, i sharet leh leassoke of ugevina, ate leassoke basar ugevina, umechal basar bechalav deorayyta.
Matkef la rav sheshet: sof sof tzonen betzonen hu! amar abbaye: gezera shemma yaale beilpas roteach.
Sof sof, keli sheni hu, ucheli sheni eno mevashshel! ella gezera shemma yaale beilpas rishon.
Mishna haof ole im haggevina al hashshulechan, veeno neechol, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel omrim: lo ole velo neechol. amar rabbi yose: zo mikkulle bet shammay umechumere bet hillel.
Beeze shulechan amru? beshulechan sheochel alav, aval beshulechan shessoder alav et hattavshil – noten ze betzad ze, veeno choshesh.

Gemara rabbi yose hayeynu tanna kamma? vechi tema: achila gufa ikka benayyhu, dekaamar tanna kamma: behaalaa ka mippalgi, baachila la peligi, vaamar leh rabbi yose: achila gufa mikkulle bet shammay umechumere bet hillel.

Vehatanya, rabbi yose omer: shishsha devarim mikkulle bet shammay umechumere bet hillel, vezo achat mehen – of ole im haggevina al hashshulechan, veeno neechol, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel omrim: lo ole velo neechol!
Ella, ha kamashma lan: man tanna kamma? rabbi yose – kol haomer davar beshem omro mevi geulla laolam, shenneemar "vattomer ester lammelech beshem mordochay".
Tena agra chamu derabbi abba: of ugevina neechalin beappikoran. hu tane la, vehu amar la: belo netilat yadayim uvelo kinnuach happe.

Rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya ikkela leve rav ashe, ayyto leh gevina – achal, ayyto leh bisra – achal, vela mesha yedeh. amri leh: veha tane agra chamu derabbi abba: of ugevina neechalin beeppikoren, of ugevina – in, basar ugevina – la!
Amar lehu: hane mille belelya, aval bimama ha chazena.
Tanya: bet shammay omrim: mekanneach, uvet hillel omrim: mediach. may "mekanneach" umay "mediach"?

a: Illema bet shammay omrim: mekanneach vela bae mediach, uvet hillel omrim: mediach vela bae mekanneach. ella ha deamar rabbi zera: en kinnuach pe ella befat, keman? kevet shammay!
Ella, bet shammay omrim: mekanneach vela bae mediach, uvet hillel omrim: af mediach. have leh mikkulle bet shammay umechumere bet hillel, velitneyay gabbe kulle bet shammay vechumere bet hillel!
Ella, bet shammay omrim: mekanneach, vehu haddin lemediach, uvet hillel omrim: mediach, vehu haddin limkanneach. mar amar chada, umar amar chada, vela peligi.
Gufa, amar rabbi zera: en kinnuach happe ella befat. vehane mille bidchitte, aval bedisare – la.
Udechitte name la amaran, ella bikrira, aval bechammima – mishtar shatri. vehane mille berakkicha, aval beakkosha – la. vehilcheta bechol mille have kinnuach, levar mikkimcha, tamre veyarka.

Bea minneh rav assi merabbi yochanan: kamma yishhe ben basar ligvina? amar lo: velo kelum. ini? veha amar rav chisda: achal basar – asur leechol gevina, gevina – muttar leechol basar! ella kamma yishhe ben gevina levasar? amar leh: velo kelum.
Gufa, amar rav chisda: achal basar – asur leechol gevina, gevina – muttar leechol basar. amar leh rav acha bar yosef lerav chisda: basar shebben hashshinnayim mahu?
Kare aleh "habbasar odennu ben shinnehem".

Amar mar ukeva: ana, leha milleta, challa bar chamra legabbe abba, deillu abba ki hava achel bisra haiddana, la hava achel gevina ad limchar ad hasheta, veillu ana – beha seodta hu dela achelna, lisodta achrita – achelna.

Amar shemuel: ana, leha milleta, challa bar chamra legabbe abba, deillu abba hava sayayr nichseh tere zimne beyoma, vaana la sayayrna ella chada zimna. shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: man desayayr nichseh kol yoma mashkach istera.
Abbaye hava sayayr nichseh kol yoma veyoma. yoma chad pega baariseh dedare pitka deufe. amar leh: hane lehecha? amar leh: leve mar. amar leh: kevar kadmuch rabbanan.

Rav assi hava sayayr nichseh kol yoma, amar: hecha ninhu kol hane istire demar shemuel? yoma chad chaza tzinnora devidka beareh, shakleh liglimeh, karcheh otveh begavva, rema kala, ato inashe sachru, [amar]: ashkachtinhu lechullehu istere demar shemuel.
Amar rav idi bar avin, amar rav yitzchak bar ashyayn: mayim rishonim mitzva, veacharonim chova.
Metivi: mayim rishonim veacharonim chova, emtzaiyyim reshut. mitzva legabbe reshut – chova kare la.
Gufa: mayim rishonim veacharonim – chova, emtzaiyyim – reshut. rishonim – notlin ben bichli ben al gabbe karka, acharonim – en notlin ella bichli, veamri lah: en notlin al gabbe karka.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu kinsa.

Mayim rishonim notlin ben bechammin ben betzonen, acharonim en notlin ella betzonen, mippene shechammin mefapein et hayyadayim veen maavirin et hazzuhama. mayim rishonim notlin ben bechammin ben betzonen, amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yannay: lo shanu ella sheen hayyad
b: Soledet bahen, aval hayyad soledet bahen en notlin bahen.

Veikka dematne la assefa, acharonim en notlin ella betzonen, aval bechammin – lo. amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yannay: lo shanu ella shehayyad soledet bahen, aval en hayyad soledet bahen – notlin. mikkelal derishonim, af al pi shehayyad soledet bahen – muttar.
Emtzaiyyim reshut. amar rav nachman: lo shanu ella ben tavshil letavshil, aval ben tavshil ligvina – chova.

Amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: mippene ma amru mayim acharonim chova? shemmelach sedomit yesh, shemmesamme et haenayim. amar abbaye: umishtechach ki kureta bechora. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: kol milcha may? amar leh: la mibbaya.
Amar abbaye: meresh hava amena, hay dela mashu mayya batrae al ara – mishshum zuhama. amar li mar: mishshum desharya ruach raa alayyhu.
Veamar abbaye: meresh hava amena, hay dela shakel midde mippatura ki naket inish kasa lemishte, shemma yeera devar kalkala basseuda. amar li mar: mishshum dekashe leruach tzerada.

Vela amaran, ella deshakel vela mahdar, aval mishkal veahdore – let lan ba. vela amaran ella chutz learba ammot, aval toch arba ammot – let lan ba. vela amaran ella midde ditzrich lisodta, aval midde dela tzerich lisodta – let lan ba.
Mar bar rav ashe kafed afillu aasita uvuchena detavle, midde ditzrichi lisudeta.
Veamar abbaye: meresh hava amena, hay dechanshi nishvavraa – mishshum menakkeruta. amar li mar: mishshum dekashe leanyuta.

Hahu gavra dahava mehaddar aleh sara deanyuta, vela hava yachel leh, deka zehir annishvavra tuva. yoma chad kerach lifta ayyavle, amar: hasheta vadday nafel biday. batar deachel, ayyti mara akrinhu leyavle, shedinhu lenahara. shameh dekaamar: vavy deappekeh hahu gavra mibbeteh.

Veamar abbaye: meresh hava amena, hay dela shate ufeya – mishshum meisuta. amar li mar: mishshum dekashe lecharsam. mishteye – kashe lecharsam, minpach beh – kashya leresha, midchayeh – kashya leanyuta. may takkanteh? leshakkeeh shakkoe.
Lecharsam dechamra – shichra, deshichra – mayya, demayya – let leh takkanta, vehayeynu deamri inashe: batar anya azla anyuta.
Veamar abbaye: meresh hava amena, hay dela achli yarka mikkisha deasar ginnaa, mishshum demichaze keraavtanuta. amar li mar: mishshum dekashe lichshafim.

Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna havo kaazli bearba, amara lehu hahi matronita: otvan bahadayychu. la otvuha. amara milleta, asarta learba. amaru inhu milleta, sharyuha. amara lehu: may ebed lechu, dela mekannach lechu bechaspa, vela ketil lechu kinna ammanayychu, vela achil lechu yarka mikkisha deasar ginnaa.

Veamar abbaye: meresh hava amena, hay dela achli yarka dinfal (attakka) [mittakka], mishshum meisuta. amar li mar: mishshum dekashe lereach happe. veamar abbaye: meresh hava amena, hay dela yatvi tute marzeva, mishshum shofchim. amar li mar: mishshum dishchichi mazzikin.

Hanhu shakolae dahavo daru chavita dechamra, beo leittefoche, otvuha tute marzeva, pekaa. ato lekammeh demar bar rav ashe, appek shippure shammeteh. ata lekammeh, amar leh: ammay taaved hachi? amar leh: hechi eeved, ki otveh beunnay?

Amar leh: at beducheta dishchichi rabbim may baet? at hu deshannet, zil shallem! amar leh: hasheta name likba li mar zimna veefra. keva leh zimna. ki meta zimna, iakkav. ki ata, amar leh: ammay la atet bezimnach? amar leh: kol mille ditzyir vachatim ucheyil umene, let lan reshuta lemishkal minneh, ad demashkechinan midde dehefkera.
Veamar abbaye: meresh hava amena, hay deshade mayya mippumma dechatzba – mishshum tzivta. amar li mar: mishshum deikka mayim haraim.
Hahu bar sheda dahava be rav pappa, azal leetoye mayya minnahara, iakkav. ki ata, amaru leh: ammay iakkavt? amar lehu: ad dechalfi mayim haraim. addehachi

a: Chazanhu deka shadu mayya mippumma dechatzba, amar: i hava yadana dirgilitu lemibad hachi, la iakkavi.
Ki ata rav dimi amar: mayim harishonim heechilu besar chazir,
Acharonim hotziu et haishsha mibbalah.
Ki ata ravin amar: rishonim heechilu besar nevela, acharonim hargu et hannefesh. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vesimanaych – ata rav dimi appeka, ata ravin katla.
Rabbi abba matne chada mehane, vachada mehane, lechumera.

Ittemar, chamme haur: chizkiyya amar en notlim mehen layyadayim, verabbi yochanan amar notlin mehem layyadayim. amar rabbi yochanan: shaalti et rabban gamliel beno shel rabbi, veochel teharot, veamar li kol gedole galil osin ken.
Chamme teverya, chizkiyya amar: en notlin mehem layyadayim, aval matbilin bahem hayyadayim. verabbi yochanan amar: kol gufo tovel bahen, aval lo panav yadav veraglav.

Hasheta kol gufo tovel bahem, panav yadav veraglav lo kol shekken? amar rav pappa: bimkoman – dechulle alma la peligi dishre, mishkal minnayyhu bemana – dechulle alma la peligi daasir. ki peligi – defaskinhu bevat birta: mar savar gazrinan bat birta attu mana, umar savar la gazrinan.
Ketannae: mayim shennifselu mishshetiyyayt behema, bechelim – pesulim, bakkarka – kesherin. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af bakkarka, tovel bahen kol gufo, aval lo panav yadav veraglav.
Hasheta, kol gufo tovel bahen, yadav veraglav lo kol shekken? ella lav defaskinhu bevat birta, uveha peligi: demar savar gazrinan bat birta attu mana, umar savar la gazrinan.
Amar rav idi bar avin, amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan: netilat yadayim lechullin, mippene serech teruma.

Veod mishshum mitzva. may mitzva? amar abbaye: mitzva lishmoa divre chachamim. rava amar: mitzva lishmoa divre rabbi elazar ben arach, dichtiv: "vechol asher yigga bo hazzav veyadav lo shataf bammayim". amar rabbi elazar ben arach: mikkan samchu chachamim lintilat yadayim min hattora.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: may mashma? dichtiv "veyadav lo shataf bemayim", ha shataf – tahor? ha tevila bae! ella hachi kaamar: veacher shello shataf – tame.

Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: lo amru netilat yadayim leferot ella mishshum nekiyyut. sevur minna: chova hu delekka, ha mitzva ikka. amar lehu rava: lo chova velo mitzva, ella reshut. ufeliga derav nachman, deamar rav nachman: hannotel yadav leferot eno ella miggasse haruach.

Amar rabba bar bar chana: hava kaemna kammeh derabbi amme verabbi assi, ayyto lekammayyhu kalkalla defere, vaachalu vela mashu yedayyhu, vela yehavu li midde, uvarech chad chad lechodeh. shema minna telat: shema minna en netilat yadayim leferot, ushema minna en mezammenin al happerot, ushema minna shenayim sheachlu – mitzva lechalek.
Tanya name hachi: shenayim sheachlu – mitzva lechalek. bamme devarim amurim? shehayu shenehem sofrim, aval echad sofer veechad bur – sofer mevarech uvur yotze.
Tanu rabbanan: netilat yadayim lechullin – ad happerek, litruma –
b: Ad happerek. kiddush yadayim veraglayim bammikdash – ad happerek, vechol davar shechotzetz bitvila bagguf – chotzetz bintilat yadayim lechullin, uvekiddush yadayim veraglayim bammikdash.
Amar rav: ad kan lechullin, ad kan litruma. ushemuel amar: ad kan ben lechullin ben litruma, lechumera. verav sheshet amar: ad kan ben lechullin ben litruma, lekulla.

Amar bar hedya: hava kaemna kammeh derabbi amme, veamar: ad kan ben lechullin ben litruma lechumera, vela tema rabbi amme mishshum dechohen hu, deha rabbi meyaysha bar bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi hu levay, veamar: ad kan ben lechullin ben litruma lechumera.
Amar rav: notel adam et shete yadav shacharit, umatne alehen kol hayyom kullo. amar lehu rabbi avina livne

a: Pakta daaravot: kegon attun dela shechichi lechu mayya, meshu yedayychu mitztzafra veatno alayyhu lechulle yoma. ikka deamri: bishat haddechak – in, shello bishat haddechak – la, ufeliga derav. veikka deamri: afillu shello bishat haddechak name, vehayeynu derav.
Amar rav pappa: hay aritta dedallae, en notlin mimmennu layyadayim, dela atu mikkoach gavra. vei mekarav legabbe davla, dekaatu mikkoach gavra – notlin mimmennu layyadayim.
Vei bezia davla, bechones mashke, melaf layyfi, umetabbel bah et hayyadayim. veamar rava: keli shennikkav bechones mashke – en notlin mimmennu layyadayim.
Veamar rava: keli sheen bo reviit – en notlin mimmennu layyadayim. ini? vehaamar rava: keli sheen machzik reviit – en notlin mimmennu layyadayim, ha machzik – af al gav delet beh.
La kashya: ha lechad, ha litre, detanya: me reviit notlin layyadayim leechad, vaafillu lishnayim.
Amar leh rav sheshet leammemar: kafditu ammana? amar leh: in. achazuta? amar leh: in. ashshiura? amar leh: in.
Ikka deamri, hachi amar leh: ammana veachazuta – kafdinan, ashshiura – la kafdinan, detanya: me reviit notlin layyadayim leechad, vaafillu lishnayim.
Vela hi, shane hatam, mishshum dekaatu mishsheyare tohora.
Atken rav yaakov minnehar pekod natla bat revieta, atken rav ashe behutzal kuza bat revieta.

Veamar rava: megufat chavit shettikkenah – notlin mimmenna layyadayim. tanya name hachi: megufat chavit shettikkenah – notlin mimmenna layyadayim. chemet uchefisha shettikkenan – notlin mehem layyadayim. sak vekuppa, af al pi shemmekabbelim – en notlin mehem layyadayim.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu leechol bemappa? mi chayyshinan dilma naga, o la?
Ta shema, ucheshennatnu lo lerabbi tzadok ochel pachot mikkevetza, notlo bemappa veochlo chutz lassukka, veen mevarech acharav. may lav – ha kevetza bae netilat yadayim?
Dilma ha kevetza – bae sukka, uvae beracha.
Ta shema: dishmuel ashkecheh lerav dekaachel bemappa, amar leh:
b: Avdin keden? amar leh: dati ketzara alay.
Ki selek rabbi zera, ashkechinhu lerabbi amme verabbi assi dekaachli bivlae chamatot. amar: tere gavre ravreve kevavtayychu, lito bidrav ushemuel? ha "dati ketzara" kaamar!
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rav tachlifa bar avimi amar shemuel: hittiru mappa leochle teruma, velo hittiru mappa leochle teharot, verabbi amme verabbi assi kohanim havo.

Ibbaya lehu: ochel mechamat maachil, tzarich netilat yadayim o la? ta shema, derav huna bar sechora hava kae kammeh derav hamenuna, belam leh umetza veachel. amar leh: i lav derav hamenuna at, la safena lach.
May tama, lav mishshum dizhir vela naga? la, dizriz kadem umashe yedeh meikkara.

Ta shema, deamar rabbi zera amar rav: lo yitten adam perusa letoch piv shel shammash, ella im ken yodea bo shennatal yadav. vehashshammash mevarech al kol kos vachos, veeno mevarech al kol perusa uferusa. verabbi yochanan amar: mevarech al kol perusa uferusa.
Amar rav pappa: bishlama derav verabbi yochanan la kashya, ha deikka adam chashuv, ha delekka adam chashuv.
Mikkol makom, ha kaamar: ella im ken yodea shennatal yadav! shane shammash, ditrid.

Tanu rabbanan: lo yitten adam perusa lashshammash, ben shehakkos beyado ben shehakkos beyado shel baal habbayit, shemma yeera devar kalkala basseuda. vehashshammash shello natal yadav – asur litten perusa letoch piv.
Ibbaya lehu: maachil, tzarich netilat yadayim, o eno tzarich?

Ta shema, detane deve menashshe: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ishsha medicha et yadah achat bammayim, venotenet pat livnah katan. amru alav al shammay hazzaken shello ratza lehaachil beyado achat, vegazru alav sheyyaachil bishte yadav.
Amar abbaye: hatam mishshum shivta.

Ta shema, daavu dishmuel ashkecheh lishmuel deka vache. amar leh: ammay ka vachet? demachyayn rabbay. ammay? deamar li: ka safet livray vela meshet yedaych. veammay la meshet? amar leh: hu achel vaana mashena?!
Amar leh: la missatyeh dela gemir, mimcha name mache! vehilcheta: ochel mechamat maachil – tzarich netilat yadayim, maachil – eno tzarich netilat yadayim.
Mishna tzorer adam basar ugevina bemitpachat achat, uvilvad shello yehu nogin ze baze. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shene achsenain ochlin al shulchan echad, ze basar veze gevina, veen choshshin.
Gemara vechi nogea ze baze, may have? tzonen betzonen hu! amar abbaye: nehi diklifa la bae, haddacha mi la bae?
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shene achsenain ochlin al shulechan vechulei. amar rav chanan bar amme amar shemuel: lo shanu ella sheen makkirin ze et ze, aval makkirin ze et ze – asur.

Tanya name hachi: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shene achsenaim shennitarchu lefunedak echad, ze ba min hatztzafon veze ba min haddarom, ze ba bachatichato veze ba bigvinato, ochlin al shulchan echad, ze basar veze gevina, veen choshshin.
Velo asru ella bitfisa achat. tefisa achat salka datach? ella keen tefisa achat.
Amar leh rav yemar bar shelemya leabbaye: shene achin, umakpidin ze al ze, mahu?
Amar leh: yomru kol hasserikin asurin, userike vayytos muttarin?!
Uletamaych, ha deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: mi sheen lo ella chaluk echad muttar lechabbeso bechullo shel moed. yomru:

a: Kol hasserikin asurin userike vayytos muttarin? hatam, ha amar mar bar rav ashe: ezoro mochiach alav.
Mishna tippat chalav shennafla al hachaticha, im yesh bah benoten taam beotah chaticha – asur. nier et hakkedera, im yesh bah benoten taam beotah kedera – asur.
Gemara amar abbaye: tamo velo mammasho bealma – deorayyta.
Dei salka datach derabbanan, mibbasar bechalav may tama la gamrinan? dechiddush hu. i chiddush hu, af al gav delekka noten taam name!
Amar leh rava: derech bishshul asra tora.
Amar rav: kevan shennatan taam bachaticha, chaticha atzmah naaset nevela, veoseret kol hachatichot kullan, mippene shehen minah.
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: mikkede rav keman amar lishmateh? kerabbi yehuda, deamar min bemino lo batel, lema peliga adderava?
Deamar rava: kasavar rabbi yehuda, kol shehu min umino vedavar acher – sallek et mino kemi sheeno, vesheeno mino rave alav umevattelo.
Amar leh: i dinfal berotev rakka – hachi name, hacha bemay askinan – dinfal berotev ava.
Umay kasavar? i kasavar efshar lesochoto muttar, chaticha ammay naaset nevela? ella kasavar efshar lesochoto asur.
Deittemar: rav verabbi chanina verabbi yochanan deamri: efshar lesochoto – asur, shemuel verabbi shimon bar rabbi veresh lakish deamri: efshar lesochoto – muttar.
Vesavar rav efshar lesochoto asur? vehaittemar: kezayit basar shennafal letoch yora shel chalav, amar rav: basar asur vechalav muttar, vei salka datach efshar lesochoto asur,
b: Chalav ammay muttar? chalav nevela hu!
Leolam kasavar rav efshar lesochoto asur, veshane hatam deamar kera "lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo" – gedi asra tora, velo chalav.

Vesavar rav gedi asra tora velo chalav? veha ittemar: chatzi zayit basar vachatzi zayit chalav shebbishshelan ze im ze, amar rav: loke al achilato, veeno loke al bishshulo. vei salka datach gedi asra tora velo chalav, aachila ammay loke? chatzi shiur hu!
Ella, leolam kasavar rav chalav name asur, vehacha bemay askinan? kegon shennafal letoch yora rotachat, demivla bala, miflat la palet.
Sof sof ki nayaych, hadar palet! keshekkadam vesilleko.

Gufa: chatzi zayit basar vachatzi zayit chalav shebbishshelan ze im ze, amar rav: loke al achilato, veeno loke al bishshulo. ma nafshach? i mitztarfin – abbishshul name lilke, i lo mitztarfin – aachila name la lilke.
Leolam la mitztarfi, uveva miyyora gedola.
Velevi amar: af loke al bishshulo, vechen tane levi bematnitin: keshem shelloke al achilato kach loke al bishshulo, uvee ze bishshul amru? bevishshul sheacherim ochlin oto mechamat bishshulo.

Veefshar lesochoto atzmo – tannae hi, detanya: tippat chalav shennafla al hachaticha, kevan shennatna taam bachaticha – hachaticha atzmah naaset nevela, veoseret kol hachatichot kullan mippene shehen minah, divre rabbi yehuda.
Vachachamim omrim: ad shettitten taam barotev uvakkefe uvachatichot.
Amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda beshello nier veshello kissa, vedivre chachamim beshennier vechissa.
May "lo nier velo kissa"? illema lo nier kelal, velo kissa kelal – mivla bala, miflat la palet.
Veella, lo nier battechilla ella bassof, velo kissa battechilla ella bassof, ammay? ha bala veha palet!
Kasavar efshar lesochoto asur.

a: Mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar: ki nier mittechilla vead sof vechissa mittechilla vead sof – asur, ammay? ha la bala kelal!
Ema: lo nier yafe yafe, velo kissa yafe yafe.

Amar mar, vedivre chachamim keshennier vechissa. may "nier" umay "kissa"? illema nier bassof velo nier battechilla, vechissa bassof velo kissa battechilla – haamrat nirin divre rabbi yehuda beha! ella nier mittechilla vead sof, vechissa mittechilla vead sof.
Mikkelal derabbanan savri: nier bassof velo nier battechilla, kissa bassof velo kissa battechilla – muttar.
Alma kasavri efshar lesochoto muttar.

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: mimmay divefshar lesochoto peligi? dilma efshar lesochoto divre hakkol asur, vehacha bemin bemino ka mippalgi, verabbi yehuda letameh deamar: min bemino lo batel, verabbanan letamayyhu deamri: min bemino batel!
Hay may? i amrat bishlama derabbanan bemin bemino hacha kerabbi yehuda sevira lehu, uveefshar lesochoto peligi – hayeynu dekaamar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda beha, vedivre chachamim beha.
Ella i amrat: efshar lesochoto divre hakkol asur, vehacha bemin bemino kamippalgi – hay nirin divre rabbi yehuda veen nirin mibbee leh, vetu la middi.
Mishna hakkechal – koro umotzi et chelbo. lo kerao – eno over alav. hallev – koro umotzi et damo, lo kerao – eno over alav.
b: Gemara amar rabbi zera amar rav: eno over alav umuttar. veha anan tenan eno over alav – mibar hu dela avar, ha issura ikka!
Bedin hu deissura name lekka, veayyeyde diva lemitne sefa: hallev koro umotzi et damo, lo kerao – eno over alav. hatam mibar hu dela avar, ha issura ikka, tena name resha eno over alav.
Lema mesayyay leh: hakkechal – koro umotzi et chelbo, lo kerao – eno over alav. hallev – koro umotzi et damo, lo kerao – koro leachar bishshulo umuttar. lev hu devae keria, aval kechal la bae keria.
Dilma lev hu desaggi leh bikria, aval kechal – la saggi leh bikria.
Veikka deamri, amar rabbi zera amar rav: eno over alav, veasur. lema mesayyay leh: "eno over alav" – mibar hu dela avar, ha issura ikka.
Bedin hu deissura name lekka, veayyeyde diva lemitne sefa: hallev koro umotzi et damo, lo kerao – eno over alav, dehatam mibar hu dela avar, ha issura ikka, tena name resha "eno over alav".
Ta shema: hakkechal – koro umotzi et chelbo, lo kerao – eno over alav. hallev – koro umotzi et damo, lo kerao – koro leachar bishshulo, umuttar. lev hu devae keria, aval kechal – la bae keria!
Dilma lev hu desaggi leh bikria, aval kechal la saggi leh bikria.
Tanya kelishna kamma derav: kechal shebbishshelo bachalavo – muttar, keva shebbishshelah bachalavah – asur.
Uma hefresh ben ze laze? ze kanus bemeav, veze en kanus bemeav.

Ketzad koro? amar rav yehuda: koro sheti vaerev, vetacho bakkotel. amar leh rabbi elazar leshammaeh: kera li, vaana echol. may ka mashma lan? matnitin hi! ha ka mashma lan: dela baenan sheti vaerev vetacho bakkotel.
Amara leh yalta lerav nachman: mikkede, kol daasar lan rachamana shera lan kevavteh, asar lan dema – shera lan kavda, nidda – dam tohar.
Chelev behema – chelev chayya, chazir – mocha deshibbuta, geruta – lishshana dichvavra.
Eshet ish – gerusha bechayye valah, eshet ach – yevama, goya – yefat toar, baenan lemechal bisra bachalava.
Amar lehu rav nachman letabbache: zavviku la kachle. vehaanan tenan: koro! hahu likdera.
Veha katane: shebbishshelo – diavad in, lechattechilla la? hu haddin daafillu lechattechilla, veayyeyde deka vae lemitne sefa keva

a: Shebbishshelah bachalavah – asura, daafillu diavad name la, tena name resha shebbishshelah.

Ki selek rabbi elazar, ashkecheh lizeri, amar leh: ikka tanna deatneyeh lerav kechal? achveyeh lerav yitzchak bar avudimi. amar leh: ani lo shaniti lo kechal kol ikkar, verav – bika matza vegadar bah gader.
Derav ikkela letatlefush, shama lehahi itteta dekaamra lachavirta: riva devisra kamma chalava bae levashshole? amar: la gemiri devasar bechalav asur, iakkav (vekaasar) [vaasar] lehu kachle.
Rav kahana matne hachi. rabbi yose bar abba matne: ana, kechal shel menika shaniti lo, umippilpulo shel rav chiyyay shena leh kechal setam.

Ravin verav yitzchak bar yosef ikkelau leve rav pappe, ayyto lekammayyhu tavshila dichchal. rav yitzchak bar yosef achal, ravin la achal. amar abbaye: ravin takkala, ammay la achal? mikkede, devethu derav pappe beratte derabbi yitzchak nappacha havay, verabbi yitzchak nappacha mareh deovada hava, i lav dishmia la mibbe nasha la hava avda.

Besura la achli kachle, befumebdita achli kachle. rame bar tamre, dehu rame bar dikkule, mippumebdita ikkela lesura bemaale yoma dechippure. appekinhu kulle alma lechachlinhu shedinhu, azal ihu naktinhu achlinhu.

Ayytu lekammeh derav chisda, amar leh: ammay taaved hachi? amar leh: meatra derav yehuda ana, deachel. amar leh: velet lach notnin alav chumere hammakom sheyyatza mishsham vechumere hammakom shehalach lesham? amar leh: chutz lattechum achaltinhu.
Uvema tevitinhu? amar leh: befuretzane. vedilma miyyen nesech (havya) [havo]? amar leh: leachar shenem asar chodesh havo.
Vedilma degazel hava? amar leh: yeush bealim hava, dikdachu behu chilfe.
Chazyeh dela hava mannach tefillin, amar leh: may tama la mannechat tefillin? amar leh: chole meayin hu, veamar rav yehuda: chole meayin patur min hattefillin.
Chazyeh dela hava ka rame chute, amar leh: may tama let lach chute? amar leh: tallit sheula hi, veamar rav yehuda:
b: Tallit sheula kol sheloshim yom petura min hatztzitzit.
Addehachi, ayytu lehahu gavra dela hava mokar avu veimmeh, kaftu.

Amar lehu: shivku, detanya: kol mitzvat ase shemmattan secharah betziddah – en bet din shellematta muzeharin aleha. amar leh chazena lach decharifat tuva. amar leh: i havet beatreh derav yehuda, achvina lach churepay.
Amar leh abbaye lerav safra: ki salkat lehatam, bei minnayyhu: kavda, ma attun beh? ki selek, ashkecheh lerav zerika. amar leh: ana shelaki leh lerabbi amme, vaachal.
Ki ata legabbeh, amar leh: lemesar nafsha – la ka mibbaya li, ki kamibbaya li – lemesar chavirta.

May shena lemesar nafsha dela mibbaya lach – ditnan: enah neeseret, lemesar chavirta name la tibbee lach! ditnan: hakkaved oseret veenah neeseret, mippene shehi poletet veenah bolaat. amar leh: dilma hatam bechavda deissura,

a: Umishshum shamnunita. mishshum dema, may?

Ki hadar selek, ashkecheh lerabbi zerika, amar leh: hay name la tibbee lach, daana veyannay bereh derabbi amme ikkalan leve yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi, vekarivu lan kanya bekofeh, vaachalna.

Matkef la rav ashe, veittema rabbi shemuel mizzerukinya: vedilma pi kane chutz likdera hava, i name michlat hava chalet leh meikkara, ki ha derav huna chalti leh bechalla, verav nachman chalti leh berotchin.
Usevar rav pappa kammeh derava lememar: challa asir. amar leh: i challa asir – ihu name asir, ki hechi defalet – hadar bala.
Rav bar sheva ikkela leve rav nachman, ayyto leh kavda shelika, vela achal. amaru leh: bar be rav dilgav la achel, umannu? rav bar shabba. amar lehu rav nachman: gamu leshabba.

Ketannae: rabbi eliezer omer: hakkaved oseret veenah neeseret, mippene sheppoletet veenah bolaat. rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: metubbelet – oseret veneeseret, sheluka – oseret veneeseret.
Rabba bar rav huna ikkela leve rabba bar rav nachman, ayyti lekammeh telat save tache, amar lehu: mi hava yaditu deatena? amaru leh: mi adifat lan minna, dichtiv: "vekarata lashshabbat oneg"!
Addehachi, ashkach hahu kavda dahava ba simpona divlia dema, amar lehu: ammay avditu hachi? amaru leh: ella hechi naaved? amar lehu: kerau sheti vaerev, vechittucha letachat.
Vehane mille kavda, aval techala – shumena bealma hu, ki ha dishmuel avdi leh tavshila ditchale beyoma deaved milleta.
Ittemar: kavda illave bisra – shere, dema mishrak sharek. kachla illave bisra – asur. may tama? chalav saroche mesarech.
Rav dimi minnehardea matne ifka: kachla illave bisra – shere, may tama? chelev shechuta derabbanan, kavda illave bisra – asir, dam deorayyta.
Daresh marimar: hilcheta, ben kavda ben kachla, tute bisra – shere, illave bisra – diavad in, lechattechilla la.
Rav ashe ikkela leve rame bar abba chamu, chazyeh livreh derame bar abba deka
b: Shafed kavda illave bisra, amar: kamma yehir hay merabbanan! emar daamur rabbanan diavad, lechattechilla mi amur?
Vei ikka be duge, bisra illave kavda name asir.
Umay shena middema devisra? dema devisra – shachen, dema dechavda – kafe.
Amar rav nachman, amar shemuel: sakkin sheshshachat bah, asur lachtoch bah roteach. tzonen – amri la baaya haddacha, veamri la la baaya haddacha.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: keara shemmalach bah basar, asur leechol bah roteach, ushemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: maliach hare hu keroteach, vechavush hare hu kimvushshal.

Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: maliach eno keroteach, vechavush eno kimvushshal. amar abbaye: ha deravin leta, dehahi pinka dahava be rabbi amme, demalach beh bisra, vetavreh. mikkede, rabbi amme talmid derabbi yochanan hava, may tama tavreh? lav mishshum dishmia leh minneh derabbi yochanan deamar: maliach hare hu keroteach!
Yatev rav kahana achu derav yehuda kammeh derav huna, veyatev vekaamar: keara shemmalach bah basar – asur leechol bah roteach, utzenon shechatacho besakkin – muttar leochlo bechuttach.
May tama? amar abbaye: hay – hettera bala, vehay – issura bala.
Amar leh rava: ki bala hettera, may have? sof sof, hay hettera deate lide issura hu, deissura kaachel! ella amar rava: hay efshar lemitameh, vehay la efshar lemitameh.

Amar leh rav pappa lerava: velitameh kappila arammaa, mi la tenan: kedera shebbishshel bah basar lo yevashshel bah chalav, veim bishshel – benoten taam, bishshel bah teruma lo yevashshel bah chullin, veim bishshel – benoten taam.
Veamrinan: bishlama teruma – taem la kohen, ella basar bechalav – man taem la? vaamar lan: litameh kappila! hachi name litameh kappila! hachi name, ki kaamena – delekka kappila.
Ittemar: dagim shealu bakkeara, rav amar: asur leachlan bechuttach, ushemuel amar: muttar leachlan bechuttach.
Rav amar: asur, noten taam hu; ushemuel amar: muttar, noten taam bar noten taam hu.

Veha derav, lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar. derav ikkela leve rav shimi bar chiyyay bar bereh, chash (beenav) [beeneh], avadu leh sheyayfa betzaa, batar hachi remo leh bishshula begavvav, taem leh tama dishyayfa, amar: yahev tama kulle hay. vela hi, shane hatam dinfish merare tefe.

Rabbi elazar hava kaem kammeh demar shemuel, ayyto lekammeh dagim shealu bakkeara, veka achel bechuttach. yahev leh vela achal, amar leh: lerabbach yehavi leh vaachal, veat la achlat? ata lekammeh derav, amar leh: hadar beh mar mishshemateh? amar leh: chas leh lezareh deabba bar abba delispe li midde vela sevira li.

Rav huna verav chiyyay bar ashe havo yatvi, chad behay gisa demabbara desura, vechad behay gisa demabbara. lemar ayyto leh dagim shealu bakkeara vaachal bechuttach, lemar ayyto leh teenim vaanavim betoch hasseuda, vaachal vela barech.

Mar amar leh lechavreh: yatma! avad rabbach hachi? umar amar leh lechavreh: yatma! avad rabbach hachi? mar amar leh lechavreh: ana kishmuel sevira li, umar amar leh lechavreh: ana kerabbi chiyyay sevira li, detane rabbi chiyyay: pat poteret kol mine maachol, veyayin poter kol mine mashkin.
Amar chizkiyya mishshum abbaye: hilcheta dagim shealu bakkeara – muttar leochlan bechuttach, tzenon shechatacho besakkin shechatach bah basar – asur leochlo bechuttach.
Vehane mille tzenon,

a: Deaggav churepeh bala, aval kishshut – garer leve fesakeh veachel.
Kilche delifta – shere, desilka – asiroy, vei petach behu delifta – shappir dame.
Bea minneh rav dimi merav nachman: mahu leannoche kadda demilcha gabbe kadda dechamka? amar leh: asur. dechalla may? amar leh: shere.
Umay shena lechi techul ala kora demilcha? may tama? hay – iteh (issura) [leissura] beeneh, vehay – leteh (issura) [leissura] beeneh.

Hahu bar gozala dinfal lechadda dechamka, sharyeh rav chinnana bereh derava mippashruneya. amar rava: man chakkim lemishre ki hay gavvna, i lav rav chinnana bereh derava mippashruneya? kasavar: ki amar shemuel "maliach hare hu keroteach", hane mille hecha deeno neechol mechamat milcho, aval hay kuttacha hare neechol mechamat milcho.
Vehane mille chay, aval tzali – bae kelifa, vei it beh pile – kulleh asur, vei metabbal betavlin – kulleh asur.
Amar rav nachman, amar shemuel: kikkar shechatach aleha basar – asur leochlah, vehane mille deasmek, vehane mille deavreye, vehane mille deasmecheh, aval kelishta – let lan ba.

Shemuel shade leh lechalbeh, rav huna yahev leh leshammaeh. ma nafshach? i shere – lechulle alma shere, i asir – lechulle alma asir! shane rav huna daanina dateh. rava achel leh, vekare leh "chamar basar".
Amar rav nachman, amar shemuel: en mannichin keli tachat basar ad sheyyichle kol mare admumit shebbo. mena yadinan? mar zutera mishshemeh derav pappa amar: mishshettaale timrato.
Matkef la rav ashe: vedilma tattaa meta, illaa la meta? ella amar rav ashe: let leh takkanta, ella mishde beh tarte galle milcha,
b: Umishpeyeh.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav ika lerav ashe: umi amar shemuel hachi? vehaamar shemuel: kikkar shechatach aleha basar asur leochlah! shane hatam, deaggav ducheka desakkina palet.
Amar rav nachman: dagim veofot shemmelachan ze im ze – asurin. hechi dame? i bichli sheeno menukkav – afillu ofot veofot name asiri, i bichli menukkav – afillu dagim veofot name shere.
Leolam bichli menukkav, vedagim mishshum dirfu keramayyhu kadmi ufalti, veofot kemiti, batar denaychi dagim palyti ofot, vahadar bali minneh.
Rav mari bar rachel immelach leh besar shechuta bahade besar terefa, ata lekammeh derava.
Amar leh: "hattemeim" – leesor tziran, verotvan, vekefe shellahen.
